title: Analyze/Evaluate Authoring Candidate Registry
methodology: Structural scan of 2,540 items across 5 packs. Candidates identified by CognitiveLevel (Apply/Understand) + DifficultyScore (>=3) + analysis-oriented topic patterns.

selection_criteria: Apply or Understand cognitive level (96.8% of pool)
Topic contains analysis-oriented keywords (variance, ratio, trend, comparison, etc.)
Certified state preferred (ready for upgrade without first-pass audit)
Multi-step calculation or interpretation requirement in stem

Section_A_Financial_Reporting.pack_distribution: Packs A, B, C, D (Sections A)

Section_B_Planning_Budgeting.pack_distribution: Packs A, B, C, D (Sections B)

Section_C_Performance_Management.pack_distribution: Packs A, B, C, D (Sections C)

candidate_topics: Process costing — FIFO vs weighted average comparison
Relevant cost identification in complex scenarios
Section_D_Cost_Management.pack_distribution: Packs A, B, C, D (Sections D)

Section_E_Internal_Controls.pack_distribution: Packs A, B, C, D, E (Sections E)

candidate_topics: Data quality issue root cause analysis
Analytics method selection for business problem
Section_F_Technology_Analytics.pack_distribution: Packs B, C, D, E (Sections F)

concerns: 3 of 10 labeled Easy — possible miscategorization (P1-A-001, P1-AC-001, P1-AD-001)
Only 1 Analyze item in 540 Pack E items
Pack A has only 1 Analyze item in 500 items
Section E (Internal Controls) has 0 Analyze items despite being ripe for analysis-level questioning

batch_1_variance_analysis.description: Existing variance calculation items (Section C/D) → upgrade to Analyze: add root-cause interpretation, multi-variance reconciliation, investigation triggers
batch_1_variance_analysis.effort: Medium — explanations need expansion, stems may need scenario update

batch_2_ratio_interpretation.description: Ratio calculation items (Section A) → upgrade to Analyze: add trend comparison, industry benchmark comparison, inter-ratio relationship analysis
batch_2_ratio_interpretation.effort: Medium — add comparative data, expand explanations

batch_3_decision_analysis.description: Make-or-buy, special order, sell-or-process items (Section D) → upgrade to Analyze/Evaluate: add qualitative factors, capacity constraints, opportunity cost analysis
batch_3_decision_analysis.effort: High — requires new distractors, expanded scenarios

batch_4_control_assessment.description: Internal control identification items (Section E) → upgrade to Analyze: add deficiency severity assessment, compensating control evaluation

batch_5_net_new_evaluate.description: Net-new Evaluate items built via S836 quality-first pipeline. Cannot upgrade from existing pool — Evaluate requires judgment under ambiguity.
batch_5_net_new_evaluate.effort: Maximum — full authoring from the S836 pipeline

rejected_candidates.definition_match_items: ~500 items (DL-031 pattern) — stem is definition, answer is term. Not upgradeable without complete rewrite.
rejected_candidates.simple_calculation_items: ~400 items — single-step arithmetic. Not viable for Analyze/Evaluate upgrade.
rejected_candidates.pack_e_understand_items: 416 items — Pack E's 77% Understand concentration is mostly definitional. Low upgrade potential without full stem rewrite.

governance_note: All items in this registry are Certified. Upgrading cognitive level requires Explanation + metadata changes only; CorrectChoice must not change unless independently verified per CAQS §5.1. Governance guard Rule 4 (answer-key WARN) applies to any difficulty recalibration.
